title: Services | FinishLines Creative Concepts
description: Fabrication, upholstery and powder coating for boats and vehicles in Apopka, Florida.

blocks.headline:
Three trades,
one roof
blocks.intro: Cut, formed, welded, coated and stitched, all of it under the same roof in Apopka, by the same family that quotes the job. Nothing gets subcontracted out and nothing comes back looking like someone else did it.

blocks.headline:
Cut, formed
& welded
blocks.text: From custom metal projects to precision CNC work, our fabrication delivers strength and creativity. Custom builds, repairs and modifications that blend innovation with craftsmanship: aluminium towers and T-tops, consoles, tanks and boxes, gates, railings and cut-metal signage.

photo.alt: Steel gate with a cut eagle medallion, fabricated by FLCC

blocks.caption: CNC plasma: custom gate medallion

blocks.headline:
Marine-grade
interiors
blocks.text: Transform your boat or vehicle interior with custom upholstery that combines comfort, style and durability. Complete restorations and repairs in marine-grade materials, at competitive rates, from a single torn cushion to a pontoon stripped to the frame and rebuilt.

blocks.headline:
A finish that
outlasts paint
blocks.text: Durable, corrosion-resistant and affordable. Unlike paint, powder coating lasts longer, resists chips and needs almost no upkeep, which matters on anything that lives outdoors or on the water. Blasted, coated and cured in-house, in a range of colours and textures.

before.heading: Raw
before.text: Blasted back to bare metal. Every weld and edge exposed.

after.heading: Coated
after.text: Electrostatically applied, oven-cured, done in a day.
